description: Draw Secret Santa pairs with a true derangement shuffle — nobody ever draws themselves. Reveal pairings or download them.

faqs.a: It uses a Fisher-Yates shuffle and re-shuffles until no one is assigned to themselves (a derangement), which is the fair Secret Santa rule.
No — the derangement guarantee means self-draws are impossible.
faqs.q: Can someone draw their own name?

faqs.a: You need at least 3 participants for a proper Secret Santa draw.
faqs.q: How many people do I need?

faqs.a: Download the pairings as a text file to share, or read them aloud from the screen.
faqs.q: How do I share the results?

faqs.a: Everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Enter one participant name per line (minimum 3).
Press Draw names to generate fair pairs with no self-draws.
Reveal the pairings or download them as a text file.
title: Secret Santa Generator
